generate_audio_from_prompt: generate audio from a text prompt using the AudioLDMPipeline with a specified number of inference steps
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLAP text embeddings using the _encode_prompt method with classifier-free guidance
decode_latents_to_mel: decode latent representations into mel spectrograms using the decode_latents method and VAE scaling factor
convert_mel_to_waveform: convert a mel spectrogram to an audio waveform using the mel_spectrogram_to_waveform method and SpeechT5HifiGan vocoder
prepare_noisy_latents: prepare initial noisy latent tensors for audio generation using the prepare_latents method with a given batch size and shape
